sloka: आगता हि महा वीर्या हरयः काम रूपिणः ।कोटि शत सहस्राणि नाना नग निवासिनः ॥४-३३-६०॥
transliteration: āgatā hi mahā vīryā harayaḥ kāma rūpiṇaḥ ।koṭi śata sahasrāṇi nānā naga nivāsinaḥ ॥4-33-60॥

translations.english: 'O great warrior monkeys residing at different mountains who can assume any form they like have arrived in hundreds and thousands of crores.
